What do you think? …

Zac Zuo

Hi everyone!

Tesla once put a Roadster in a rocket. Now there's a rocket in the Roadster.

At the reveal, it drove up a wall and held itself upside down with fan suction, then left the ramp, rolled in midair with cold-gas thrusters and landed on its wheels. Later it hopped over a Tesla Semi.

The suction fans come on every trim, including the Performance version you can reserve now. Thrust adds rear thrusters for 0-60 in under a second. Only the invite-only Rocket gets the full set, and that's the one that flies. It isn't approved for public roads.
